{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZhykJg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDIsrY", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 109, "title": "Add an evidence-qualified Wakaba beginner-board journey from MAIN 16", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `76d28498ff84100ac04c2a6a76be5765434f8569`, entering `16` from MAIN or the index opens a generic article list containing zero articles. Users cannot experience Wakaba as a place for communication beginners to read contributions, ask questions or reply.

This is an existing fidelity gap. The inspected evidence does not identify it as a regression introduced by PR #108.

## Expected outcome

Provide this browser-local journey:

`MAIN → 16 → Wakaba welcome → 1 → beginner board → LIST / READ / UNREAD / NEXT → WRITE or REPLY → review/save or cancel → BACK → welcome → BACK → actual caller`

Use one original board named `はじめての広場`, with welcome selector `1`. An internal mapping such as `LOCAL-WAKABA:1` can reuse the existing SIG/forum storage structure. The name, selector and internal mapping are **category D implementation choices**, not recovered historical identifiers.

A pristine new world receives three short original contributions from at least two existing fictional residents, including a question and an explicitly linked reply. Existing, imported and deliberately emptied worlds receive no Wakaba examples automatically. Human participation remains available through the existing successful-submission transaction, including when the local board is initially absent.

## Context

### Historical evidence and reconstruction tolerance

Sources inspected live on 2026-10-24:

- The [Paradise Army reproduction](https://paradisearmy.com/doujin/pasok3pc-van.htm) labels its later MAIN example circa 1996 and places Wakaba at selector 16. Confidence is high in the reproduction’s contents; historical applicability remains provisional. The page carries a December 1999 credit, which does not date every revision. It supplies no Wakaba secondary menu.
- The [participant reference](https://www2s.biglobe.ne.jp/nozomin/kanri/pcvan.html) explicitly describes Wakaba as a corner for communication beginners. This is firsthand retrospective documentation with undated practices: moderate historical confidence for that purpose, without authentication of its 1996 configuration or controls. Do not adopt its closure chronology as independently established.
- The [まいとーく client-author description](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/net/se024554.html) includes Wakaba among locations covered by message retrieval/writing and separately names Wakaba OLT attendance/participation. Confidence is high in the stated capabilities. Grouped client features do not prove identical host workflows across services; release dating and applicability throughout 1996 remain unresolved.
- A [Vector catalog search result](https://www.vector.co.jp/vpack/filearea/win95/net/comm/pcvan) displays version 2.31 with a `22.10.05` publication label. Direct catalog opening and the [package metadata page](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/dl/win95/net/se024554.html) returned cache misses. This does not establish the description’s target-year release history; no package was downloaded.

Focused searches using Japanese/English names, 1995/1996 dates and the publisher archive recovered no qualifying period Wakaba directory or session. Investigation continued through the accessible participant, client-author and reproduction sources after metadata retrieval failed.

**Accepted tolerance:** moderate confidence in a beginner reading/contribution experience; low confidence in exact 1996 secondary screens and commands. Reuse the application’s existing LIST/READ/UNREAD/NEXT and composer controls as disclosed category D reconstruction. Board wording, spacing, welcome selector, storage representation and fictional conversation are authored choices. Do not present Wakaba as an authenticated SIG directory or add a claimed historical `J WAKABA` shortcut. Do not manufacture mandatory graduation rules, conflict stereotypes or exact opening/closure dates from unsupported summaries.

### Implementation and existing evidence

- `src/sections.ts` maps `16` to `articles`; `src/navigation.ts:openSection` and its section renderer produce the current empty collection.
- `src/navigation.ts` already supplies forum rendering, parent navigation and destination exposure. `src/forums.ts:forumName` currently assumes MITI, DAISIZEN or an expanded board; add Wakaba resolution deliberately without inserting it into an authenticated directory.
- `src/main.ts` refreshes forum content and persists the exact NEXT candidate before rendering. Expose the Wakaba board through the existing destination/content-refresh path, including the connection wrapper.
- `src/commands.ts` and `src/composer.ts` already implement human selection, reply selection, line entry, preview/edit/cancel and confirmed save.
- `src/storage/repository.ts:createForumPost` can create a missing directory/board inside the successful submission transaction. Reuse its numbering, parent validation, ambiguity rejection and rollback.
- `readActivity` distinguishes pristine initialization through `bootstrap`. The current `populateCommunity` helper is also called by legacy-world opt-in, and `expandCommunity` can extend eligible existing worlds. Wakaba starter insertion must be confined to pristine initialization rather than added unconditionally to either reusable helper.
- `src/ai/activity.ts` can select stored forums under existing consent and scheduling. Preserve that policy and resident preferences. If adding a distinct starter origin, recognize it in the existing public-conversation eligibility helper; provide a concise beginner-oriented board culture through the existing prompt-data path. Do not promise an automatic resident answer or add a new scheduling mechanism.

[Issue #5](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/5) established MAIN mapping; [Issue #33](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/33) established preservation of empty local collections. [Issue #107](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/107) is completed and explicitly excluded Wakaba. Current repository-scoped open-Issue/open-PR queries returned no items; Wakaba history searches found these neighboring scopes without an equivalent handoff. Lexical duplicate detection is incomplete and inventory can change.

[PR #108](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/108) and `docs/validation.md` report 42 focused and 392 complete-suite passing checks with three workers, including configured type checking/build. These are Coordinator records, not checks run by this research graph. Default/eight-worker reliability remains unresolved.

Scope is one Wakaba board. Wakaba OLT, the full historical directory, other MAIN destinations and exact host paging/editor behavior remain separate gaps.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Replace MAIN/index selector 16’s article placeholder with the short Japanese welcome and selectable beginner board. Keep MAIN labels intact. HELP/LIST are useful; BACK restores the actual welcome/caller stack, including index entry; MAIN returns directly to MAIN. Reject invalid selections without writes. Welcome screens expose no forum composition target until the board is selected. Existing SIG directories and jump commands remain unchanged.
- [ ] Reuse existing forum listing, numbered reading, unread listing, NEXT, identity/date/reply rendering and WRITE/REPLY composition. Preserve per-human/forum high-water semantics, fresh cross-tab content and selection, exact persisted/rendered NEXT candidates, anonymous browsing and existing failure behavior. Failed read-marker saves reveal no newly selected body. Missing/empty collections remain navigable and explain how to begin; ambiguous mappings must not select an arbitrary board.
- [ ] Add the three original starter contributions only within pristine initialization, atomically with valid references and provenance. Reuse existing fictional residents and calendar anchoring; do not create historical identities or new resident profiles. Keep existing fixture content intact. Reopening, reconnecting, browsing, consenting, legacy population, existing-world expansion, another tab and JSON restore must not add Wakaba examples to an existing/imported/deleted/restored-empty collection. An explicitly confirmed reset may create the normal pristine starter world.
- [ ] In a world lacking the Wakaba board, successful human WRITE may create only the required local directory/board and contribution through `createForumPost`. Opening/cancelling a draft, invalid input or a failed submission creates none of them. Preserve transactional numbering, same-board reply validation, ambiguity rejection, concurrent-tab behavior and rollback. Support reload and JSON round-trip without a database-version or backup-format migration.
- [ ] Add focused controller, production-terminal and IndexedDB coverage using existing Playwright helpers. Cover MAIN and index entry/return; pristine reading and reply/save/cancel; gapped unread progression; anonymous HANDLE guidance; missing/empty/duplicate mappings; lazy first submission and rollback; concurrent initialization; existing/legacy/imported/deleted collections; reload/restore/reset; and current cross-tab content. Update aggregate starter-count assertions while retaining assertions that all previous records and safeguards survive.
- [ ] Preserve functional, storage, consent, IME and terminal regression coverage. In deterministic inactive fixtures, compare protected records: browsing changes only normal session/history bookkeeping; reading additionally permits the intended marker; submission permits only the intended post, counter and necessary missing directory records. Mail, conference/OLT, unrelated boards/settings, resident preferences and consent remain unchanged. Retain literal Japanese/markup rendering, focus, log export, composition input ownership, simulated IME guards and pacing/skip. New board prompt data must not include private-mail or OLT context. No model download, real inference or external service is needed for acceptance.
- [ ] Update README’s menu map, affected navigation/storage documentation, research records and discoverable Settings/About with the actual subset, fictional provenance, source scope/access dates, confidence and category D assumptions. Keep routine terminal output concise. The Coordinator runs the new focused coverage plus affected existing navigation/forum/composition/community/repository journeys, then `npm test -- --workers=3`; configured servers already perform TypeScript checking and production build. Record actual failures, corrections, skips and worker settings. Review the complete diff, affected links and `git diff --check`. Do not claim that three-worker success resolves default-worker reliability.

## Optional validation

Compare against a subsequently recovered dated Wakaba manual/session. Former-user feedback and native Japanese IME checks may refine presentation, but are not completion gates. No real-model inference is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. All acceptance checks are achievable before merge against local production assets.
